Gold-standard reference transcript for german_multispeaker_conversation.wav
(manually authored to match exactly what was passed to SAPI — see README.md).
Used for qualitative/structural STT evaluation, not automated WER scoring
(no WER metric is computed by this project — see
PHASE_3_VALIDATION_REPORT.md's STT evaluation section for why).

Timing is approximate (source TTS parts concatenated with 0.6s silence gaps).

[Speaker A, ~0.0s-6.6s]
Guten Tag, mein Name ist Anna. Ich moechte heute ueber das Projekt sprechen.

[silence, ~6.6s-7.2s]

[Speaker B, ~7.2s-11.9s]
Hallo Anna, das freut mich zu hoeren. Wie ist der aktuelle Stand?

[silence, ~11.9s-12.5s]

[Speaker A, ~12.5s-18.7s]
Wir sind fast fertig. Die Dokumentation wird naechste Woche abgeschlossen.

Expected speaker count: 2
Expected speaker turns: 3 (A, B, A)
Expected language: German (de)
